original_test_intent: Demonstrate that the GB-NV-PVP system and its installed PSU/input-power path satisfy the product's EDPp transient limit under every required NVQual Test #7 load scenario.
original_method: Approve a versioned NVQual/HMC scenario recipe and EDPp acceptance definition; instrument the specified AC/DC input point with calibrated bandwidth and synchronized timing; record idle baseline; execute each bounded workload once while collecting complete waveforms and platform health; compute peaks over the prescribed window; compare to the limit and recover safely.
manual_activity: Power-test personnel validate wiring, calibration, supply/cable/facility ratings, cooling, emergency controls, and continuously supervise the critical-load run.
required_inputs: Pinned NVQual Test #7/HMC harness and configuration
Product EDPp limit, tolerance, measurement domain, aggregation/window, and pass rule
Complete workload/scenario, duration, repetition, and steady-state entry matrix
PSU population, input topology, cable/facility limits, and instrument connection point
Calibrated sample rate/bandwidth/range with time synchronization
Thermal, electrical, reset, health, abort, cooldown, and recovery thresholds
safety_requirements: Validate instrument isolation, rating, calibration, and wiring
Confirm PSU/cable/PDU/facility capacity and cooling before load
Abort on current/voltage/thermal excursions, clipping, reset, instability, or data loss
Never bypass protection or discard transient samples
Do not rerun an abnormal peak until engineering review
agent_execution_scope: Orchestrate authorized collection and correlate harness/load/instrument timestamps
Check trace completeness, clipping, gaps, units, and peak calculation
Do not invent EDPp thresholds, approve high-energy wiring, bypass protections, repeat failed load, or declare DUT PASS
engineer_actions: Define EDPp measurement and product acceptance
Approve NVQual scenarios and electrical/thermal envelope
Supervise the instrumentation and critical-load window
Review anomalies and issue PASS, FAIL, or BLOCKED

review_improvement: Turns an undefined high-load comparison into a reproducible transient-power experiment while preserving product-specific ownership and preventing low-rate or unsafe substitutes.
independent_technical_reasoning: EDPp is sensitive to where power is measured and over what interval a peak is evaluated. A one-second management sample can look compliant while the electrical input experiences a shorter over-limit excursion, whereas an unqualified instantaneous spike may not match a product-defined averaging window. The review therefore requires raw calibrated waveforms, synchronized workload phase markers, and an explicit mathematical acceptance rule. Because generating the transient stresses the complete input and cooling path, orchestration is possible only after humans validate ratings and abort limits; a tool-only result cannot own the verdict.
